games.title: Number pattern
games.question: What comes next? 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, …
games.explanation: The gaps grow by 2 each time: +4, +6, +8, +10, so the next gap is +12.

games.title: Who's who
games.question: Riya is taller than Sam. Sam is taller than Tara. Tara is taller than Vik. Who is the second shortest?
games.explanation: From tallest to shortest: Riya, Sam, Tara, Vik. Second shortest is Tara.

games.title: Painted cube
games.question: A wooden cube is painted red on every side, then cut into 27 equal small cubes. How many small cubes have exactly 2 red faces?
games.explanation: Cubes with 2 painted faces sit on the edges (not corners). A cube has 12 edges with 1 such cube each: 12.

games.title: Team trouble
games.question: Your project partner hasn't done their part, and the deadline is tomorrow. What do you do first?
options: Do their part yourself and say nothing
Message them privately to ask what's going on and plan together
Post about it in the class group
games.explanation: Talking privately first solves the problem and keeps the relationship.

games.title: One bottle, many ideas
games.question: How many different uses for an empty plastic bottle can you think of? You have 45 seconds. One idea per line.
games.explanation: There's no right answer. More different ideas means more creative thinking.
